description: Calculates when an LLC's next annual report or franchise tax is due in a given state and the amount owed, and returns the state's rule text, late-filing consequences where the dataset has them (penaltyAndNotes), and the official state source URLs. Use when the user asks when their LLC's annual report is due, how often it is filed, or what happens if it is late. States that key the deadline to the formation anniversary or quarter need formationDate; without it the tool says so instead of guessing a date.

formationDate.description: The LLC's formation date as ISO yyyy-mm-dd. Required for anniversary- and quarter-based states.

state.description: Two-letter state code or full state name, e.g. "WY" or "Wyoming". All 50 states + DC.

name: get_annual_report_deadline
title: Get the next annual-report deadline
